scope: Painted eye textures for the editable native Wolfos master
open:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: transparent square RGBA eye texture for an animated 3D Wolfos enemy in an Ocarina of Time styled game remaster.
Create ONE standalone OPEN wolf eye, painted albedo only, with no scene or surrounding head. The reference 16px texture is ONLY a UV-layout guide: match its diagonal eye orientation and occupied area, but replace the glowing solid eye with clear anatomy. The closeup is reference for the game's angular dark-fantasy character style, not a request for another character rendering.
Layout: square 1024x1024 canvas. One pointed almond-shaped eye runs from the bottom-left corner area (about x=90,y=910) to the upper-right area (about x=900,y=115). Eye center at x=510,y=510. Keep all edges inside the canvas and the corners transparent. Broad open aperture, an almost circular iris centered in the aperture, naturally clipped by the lids. Full iris diameter approximately 400 px. A clearly readable dark ROUND wolf pupil about 140 px across, olive-gold amber iris with a darker outer limbal ring and restrained radial painted fibers; small single cream catchlight. No feline slit pupil. No solid white or green glowing core. Warm muted olive sclera at the pointed corners. Thin dark umber upper and lower eyelid rims with subtle warm ochre edging, no surrounding fur or facial skin.
Style: deliberate hand-painted stylized game texture, soft organic color variation with clean readable shapes, compatible with classic Zelda art, no photorealism. Low contrast peripheral edge with rich but restrained amber-gold iris. No baked cast shadow, no lighting bloom, no text, no labels, no frame, no duplicate eyes, no face.
Transparent background. Preserve the full RGBA alpha, including a clean anti-aliased contour.
half:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: HALF-BLINK frame of the attached transparent square game eye texture. Edit target is image 1, the painted open amber wolf eye.
Create exactly one matching half-blink texture. Keep the canvas, outer almond silhouette, diagonal orientation from bottom-left to top-right, position, iris center, iris pattern, pupil size, colors and brush style IDENTICAL. Do NOT move, shrink, squash or rotate the eyeball. The upper eyelid has descended across the eye, covering the UPPER 55 percent of its aperture with a dark warm-umber eyelid painted in the same understated style as the border; this is an occluding lid sliding over the same eye. The top half of the amber iris and the top half of the black pupil are hidden behind the eyelid. The bottom half of the pupil and iris remain visible in place. The iris does not deform. The lower eyelid remains still. Follow the eye's diagonal tilt: closing movement is perpendicular to its long bottom-left/top-right axis. Thin dark lash edge on the new lid boundary. Preserve the outer original eye contour and transparent space outside it. No glowing crescent, no new catchlights, no skin beyond the existing almond, no second eye, no head, no text. This will be swapped on the SAME mesh during a blink, so registration and identity must match precisely. Transparent background.
closed:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: CLOSED BLINK frame of the attached transparent square game eye texture. Image 1 is the original open eye and image 2 is the matching half-blink, both edit references for exact registration.
Create exactly one fully CLOSED eye texture, matching image 1's square canvas, same outer almond silhouette, same diagonal bottom-left-to-top-right orientation, placement, warm dark-umber eyelid colors, and hand-painted brush style. Preserve all transparent space outside the original almond.
The upper lid has fully descended and touches the lower lid: the entire amber iris, dark pupil, cream corner sclera and catchlight are hidden under the warm brown eyelid. NO gold, yellow, white or bright eye remains visible. A thin elegant dark closed lash crease follows the lower part of the almond from bottom-left tip to upper-right tip; slightly curved with no open aperture. Keep the same lower rim and a subtle ochre accent at the crease, no metallic shine or bright lash. Most of the original almond is now continuous softly painted dark umber eyelid, subtly curved by broad tonal variation. Use the restrained palette from the half-blink upper lid. No surrounding facial skin, fur, eyebrow, or head. No second eye, no text, no layout labels. This is the closed frame for the SAME mesh: do not change the outer silhouette, canvas scale or eye position. Transparent RGBA background.
